description: Free facts about Next Generation Movers; takes no inputs. Use this to check who the carrier is before quoting or booking, or to answer questions about licensing, service area, hours or how to reach the company. It does not price a move (use get_quote_free) or hold a date (use request_booking). Returns name, summary, base city (Rockville, MD), coverage, USDOT 3764697 and MC 1341637, website, phone, agent email, services, hours, example routes and a verified_carrier record.
